issues.description: Using @ts-ignore to suppress TypeScript errors is a code smell that hides potential type safety issues. The neverchange library likely lacks proper TypeScript definitions.
issues.suggestion: Either add proper TypeScript types for the neverchange library or install @types/neverchange if available. Consider using 'any' type explicitly with a comment explaining why instead of @ts-ignore.

issues.description: Variable 'db' is typed as 'any' which completely removes TypeScript type safety. This defeats one of the main benefits of using TypeScript.
issues.suggestion: Define a proper interface for the NeverChangeDB type or use a more specific type annotation.

issues.description: The initDb() function has a logic error. The statement 'if(db) db;' does nothing - it checks if db exists but then just references it without returning.
issues.suggestion: Change line 7 to: 'if(db) return;' to prevent re-initialization of the database.

issues.description: Missing validation of the 'text' parameter in addTodo(). Empty or null strings should be rejected before attempting database insertion.
issues.suggestion: Add input validation: 'if (!text || text.trim().length === 0) throw new Error("Todo text cannot be empty");'

issues.description: The addTodo() function logs success but throws errors inconsistently with other functions like updateTodo and deleteTodo.
issues.suggestion: Establish a consistent error handling pattern across all functions - either all throw or all log.

issues.description: The getTodos() function doesn't validate that db is initialized before attempting a query. All public functions are vulnerable to this issue.
issues.suggestion: Add a check: 'if (!db) throw new Error("Database not initialized. Call initDb() first.");'

issues.description: No exported type definitions or interfaces. The module's type contract is unclear - callers don't know what types to expect.
issues.suggestion: Export type definitions: 'export interface Todo { id: number; text: string; completed: boolean; deleted: boolean; }'

issues.description: The initDb() function should handle concurrent calls gracefully. If called twice simultaneously, it may create race conditions.
issues.suggestion: Add a promise-based initialization flag to track ongoing initialization.

codeQuality.summary: The code has several significant quality issues that impact type safety, error handling, and maintainability. The critical issue is the broken initialization check (if(db) db; should be if(db) return;). Type safety is severely compromised with 'any' types and @ts-ignore directives. Error handling is inconsistent across functions. Input validation is missing, and database initialization doesn't protect against concurrent calls.

testCoverage.summary: The src/db.ts file has ZERO test coverage. All six exported functions are completely untested. Critical gaps include: no migration testing, no CRUD operation testing, missing error handling tests, and no data persistence verification. The code is vulnerable to runtime errors when called before initialization.

suggestions.description: The condition 'if(db) db;' does nothing - should use early return.
suggestions.before:
export async function initDb() {
  if(db) db;
suggestions.after:
export async function initDb() {
  if(db) return;
suggestions.benefits: Prevents duplicate database initialization and fixes logic bug.

issues.description: New untested dependency 'neverchange' at version 0.0.1 poses significant security risk. Pre-release version indicates initial/unstable release with no established track record.
issues.suggestion: Thoroughly audit the neverchange library before merging. Consider pinning to exact version instead of using caret range.

issues.suggestion: Pin to exact version using '0.0.1' instead of '^0.0.1' until the package reaches version 1.0.0.

Additionally, the project lacks standard metadata fields (engines, repository, bugs) and proper documentation explaining the rationale for including an alpha-stage dependency.

recommendations.description: Fix the logic error in initDb() function. The statement 'if(db) db;' (line 7) does nothing. Change to 'if(db) return;' to prevent duplicate initialization and potential race conditions.
Review and validate the 'neverchange@0.0.1' dependency before merging. This is a pre-release package with no established track record. Either pin to exact version or wait for stable 1.0.0 release.
Replace 'any' type usage throughout src/db.ts with proper TypeScript interfaces. Remove @ts-ignore and define proper types for NeverChangeDB, migrations, and Todo records.

Standardize error handling patterns across database functions. Currently inconsistent: addTodo only logs, toggleTodo has no handling, updateTodo/deleteTodo throw errors. Create a common error handling wrapper.

Add comprehensive test coverage for database layer. Currently 0% coverage. Priority: test all CRUD operations, migrations, error paths, and edge cases like null db instance and concurrent initialization.
